title: Wildfly: unauthenticated remote attacker connecting with the CORE protocol can discover cluster node details by…
description: A security vulnerability in Wildfly allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to discover cluster node details by sending a SUBSCRIBE_TOPOLOGY request using the CORE protocol before authentication. This information disclosure affects versions prior to 42.0.0-r1. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5. A patch is available in version 42.0.0-r1.
